post.summary: Answers whether the guess was right; 403 when banned or out of attempts.

get.summary: The caller's own guesses, newest first.
Ids of the challenges the caller has solved, e.g. to mark them in the list.

value.description: Points each solver gets now: the best current value of its flags, which decays as more players solve it.

solves.description: Ranked players who solved it; hidden, banned and admin accounts don't count.

solved.description: Whether the caller solved it; null for guests.

attemptsLeft.description: Wrong guesses the caller has left; null for guests, once solved, and without a limit.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the field, as a fragment, e.g. #/username or #/items/1/name.

type.description: A URI for the kind of problem; about:blank means the status says it all.

title.description: The status's standard phrase, e.g. Not Found.

detail.description: What went wrong this time, for people to read.

errors.description: The body's fields that broke a limit; only on 400s from request validation.

description.description: Markdown; inline HTML is sanitized when shown.

maxAttempts.description: Wrong guesses allowed per player; 0 means no limit.

timeLimit.description: Seconds to solve after starting; 0 means no limit.

token.description: From the link in the reset email.

pattern.description: Regular expression (Java syntax) a whole submission must match.

decayValue.description: How fast the value drops with solves; required unless decayFun is static.

minValue.description: The value never drops below this; at most baseValue. Required unless decayFun is static.

ctfName.description: Shown in the page title and the header.

registrationOpen.description: Whether new players can create accounts.

maxTeamSize.description: The most players a team can have.

ipAddress.description: The submitter's IP address; null for guesses recorded before it was kept.

userAgent.description: The submitter's browser, as it reported itself; null when it didn't.

team.description: The player's username; teams aren't scored yet.

lastAccept.description: Unix seconds of the last accepted flag; absent without solves.
